rules:
Third-backbone replication: InternVL3-2B (OpenGVLab/InternVL3-2B-hf, revision
cb57a075cb75a2e6d1b668b128d48bb00ae321d2), run under the round-2 protocol.
Why this backbone: every positive result so far is on Qwen-family backbones (Qwen3.5-4B; the
round-2 second backbone Qwen2.5-VL-3B is the same family), and the only non-Qwen backbone tried
(SmolVLM2-2.2B) was degenerate at the 4-epoch cap. InternVL3-2B is a non-Qwen vision stack
(InternViT) that fits the 8 GB card. Its language model is initialised from Qwen2.5 -- disclosed
here, so claims from it are "non-Qwen vision encoder and VLM training", not "unrelated LLM".
Chosen before any training or evaluation of this model on CourtDyn inputs.

PROTOCOL. The round-2 protocol (results/courtdyn/backbone2_r2/PREREGISTRATION.json, rules_sha256
003f2e1a80e4153cced6a2b512c1aee3bb9fd936ceea821ab8dcea07d3b1c7a4) applies verbatim, with backbone2_r2 read as backbone3_internvl:
same pools, recipe (lr 1e-4, cosine, warmup 0.03, grad_accum 16, LoRA r 16 on the language
model's q/k/v/o/gate/up/down projections, vision tower and projector frozen, seed 42, nf4 evaluation),
4-epoch schedule with a checkpoint every 70 steps, the same 280-item Q1_side dev set, the same
STOPPING RULE (k* = smallest k in {1,2,3,4} with parse rate >= 0.90 AND >= 5 distinct parsed answers
in EACH family for the metre-only adapter; otherwise k* = 4 and "degenerate at the 4-epoch cap"),
the mixed-unit adapter at the same k*, the same test cells and arms, R1, R3, R4 exactly as round 1
and R2 as amended in round 2 (a cell counts toward "replicates" only if R >= 10 AND Spearman
rho(centimetre answers, reference) >= 0.30), the same degeneracy readings and the same
interpretation clause.

DIFFERENCES from round 2, fixed now:
(a) No round-1 base results exist for this model, so the bare backbone is run fresh on the same
    base cells (explicit arms, both test clips) and the same 392-item text probe; R3 uses them.
(b) Image budget: InternVL has no pixel-cap knob. Each frame is one 448x448 tile (image
    processor max_patches = 1, no dynamic tiling; pinned by tools/internvl_launch.py for evaluation
    and train/train_qlora_internvl.py for training), 4 frames per item, ~1.1k tokens per item.
    The processor's own default (dynamic tiling, 3 tiles per 960x540 frame, ~3.2k tokens) does not
    fit 8 GB in training. 448x448 = 200,704 px per frame equals Qwen's max_pixels cap, but the
    frame is squashed to a square rather than aspect-preserved. Reported, not tuned.
(c) Training reuses train/train_qlora.py and train/train_qlora_epochs.py byte-unchanged; the
    InternVL family spec and image policy are injected from outside by train/train_qlora_internvl.py.
(d) Runs before this record, disclosed: smoke tests only -- a 2-step training run into a scratch
    directory (discarded), greedy answers to 4 dev-set items from the bare backbone and from that
    2-step adapter, and 4 text-probe items. No test cell was evaluated and no dev statistic was
    computed.
No test-cell result may change k*, the recipe or these rules.
smoke_tests_before_this: see rules (d); no test cell, no dev statistic
